ex.s: Sometimes, the parents ___28___ complain about the role of screens in family life are just as guilty of spending too much time in front of one.
ex.t: 父母需要限制自己和尤其是孩子的屏幕时间——即使这意味着扮演坏人角色。

defs.def: having done sth illegal; being responsible for sth bad that has happened 犯了罪；有过失的；有罪责的

ex.s: But he never feels guilty about the harm he is doing.
ex.t: 但他从不为自己造成的伤害感到内疚。

ex.s: Oh no, the common man is every bit as guilty; otherwise, people and nations would have rebelled long ago!
ex.t: 哦不，普通人同样有罪；否则，人民和各国早就起义反抗了！

ex.s: Although it was completely innocent, Claire felt guilty.
ex.t: 虽然这件事完全是无辜的，但克莱尔感到内疚。
